title: Integration along the structure morphism
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of $k_0$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\geq1$, $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $a=a_\beta:\beta\to s$ be a separated finite-type proper structure morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], exceptionally admissible in the constructible sense of [def-trf-admissibility]. For $T\in\{\beta,s\}$, work on the small pro-etale sites with $D(T,A)=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_T)$ and constant coefficient objects $A_T$ placed in degree zero, as in the finite-level clause of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Specialize [def-trf-dualizing-complex] to $Y=\beta$ and put $\omega_{\beta,A}=Ra^!A_s$, using its specified constructible exceptional inverse image on the same small pro-etale coefficient categories. Thus the $Ra^!$ defining $\omega_{\beta,A}$ is precisely the right adjoint in the constructible adjunction specified by [def-trf-admissibility]. The constant object is constructible [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible] and has Tor amplitude $[0,0]$, since $A_T\otimes_A^L M=M$; thus it lies in $D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and exceptional admissibility places $\omega_{\beta,A}$ in the same subcategory. This is the full subcategory specified by [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], so every morphism $\tau:A_\beta\to\omega_{\beta,A}$ in $D(\beta,A)$ is also a morphism in $D^b_{ctf}(\beta,A)$, to which the restricted functor $Ra_!$ applies. In particular both inputs are bounded and of etale origin by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], within the domain of the compactification comparisons below.

Use the ordinary derived direct image $Ra_*$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and the adjunction $La^*\dashv Ra_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The canonical identification $La^*A_s\simeq A_\beta$ is the finite-level constant-ring pullback identification of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Denote the resulting unit map by
$$
\eta_\beta:A_s\longrightarrow Ra_*A_\beta.
$$
Let $P_a:Ra_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra_!$ be the proper identification, oriented as displayed. Concretely, take the compactification $(\operatorname{id}_\beta,a)$ in [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Its candidate is $Ra_*(\operatorname{id}_\beta)_!=Ra_*$: the extension-by-zero construction [def-weil-extension-by-zero] is the identity when the open immersion is the identity, since every object factors through it and the presheaf being sheafified is already the given sheaf. Compare this candidate to the chosen $Ra_!$ using the natural, common-refinement-independent comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. This defines $P_a$ on the bounded etale-origin domain just specified.

Write $R\Gamma(s,-)$ for termwise sections on the derived category of $A_s$-modules, which is defined because sections are exact by [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. On $s$, the constant coefficient sheaf has sections $A$, so $R\Gamma(s,A_s)=A[0]$. For the proper $\beta$, use $P_a$ to identify ordinary and compact-support coefficient complexes, and write
$$
R\Gamma(\beta,K)=R\Gamma(s,Ra_!K)\simeq R\Gamma(s,Ra_*K)
\qquad(K=A_\beta,\omega_{\beta,A}).
$$
The *integration* (the trace along $a_\beta$) is the map
$$
\int_\beta:\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\beta,A)}(A_\beta,\omega_{\beta,A})\longrightarrow A
$$
which sends $\tau:A_\beta\to\omega_{\beta,A}$ to the scalar represented by the following composite in $D(A\text{-}\mathrm{Mod})$:
$$
\begin{aligned}
A[0]=R\Gamma(s,A_s)
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(s,\eta_\beta)}R\Gamma(s,Ra_*A_\beta)
\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(s,P_a(A_\beta))}R\Gamma(s,Ra_!A_\beta)\\
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(s,Ra_!\tau)}R\Gamma(s,Ra_!\omega_{\beta,A})
=R\Gamma(s,Ra_!Ra^!A_s)
\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(s,\varepsilon_a(A_s))}R\Gamma(s,A_s)=A[0].
\end{aligned}
$$
Here $\varepsilon_a(A_s):Ra_!Ra^!A_s\to A_s$ is the counit of the specified constructible adjunction $Ra_!\dashv Ra^!$ in [def-trf-admissibility], evaluated at $A_s$; no unrestricted ambient exceptional adjoint is used. Explicitly, to read this derived endomorphism $v:A[0]\to A[0]$ as a scalar, take $H^0(v)(1)\in A$, using the cohomology functor of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. This is the usual identification $\operatorname{End}_{D(A\text{-}\mathrm{Mod})}(A[0])=A$. In the shorter notation above the defining composite is
$$
A[0]\xrightarrow{\eta^*}R\Gamma(\beta,A_\beta)
\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(\beta,\tau)}R\Gamma(\beta,\omega_{\beta,A})
\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{a_\beta}}A[0],
$$
where $\eta^*=R\Gamma(s,P_a(A_\beta))\circ R\Gamma(s,\eta_\beta)$ and $\varepsilon_{a_\beta}=R\Gamma(s,\varepsilon_a(A_s))$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
and the coefficient
conventions, $A=A_{E,n}$, $s=\Spec k$, and let $\beta$ be
separated finite type
and proper over $s$,
with exceptionally
admissible structure morphism
$a_\beta:\beta\to s$ and $\omega_{\beta,A}$ the
dualizing complex of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex]. The *integration* (the
"trace along $a_\beta$") is the map

$$
\int_\beta:
\Hom_{D(\beta,A)}\bigl(A_\beta,\omega_{\beta,A}\bigr)\longrightarrow A
$$

sending $\tau:A_\beta\to\omega_{\beta,A}$ to the composite

$$
A\xrightarrow{\ \eta^*\ }
R\Gamma(\beta,A_\beta)
\xrightarrow{R\Gamma(\tau)}
R\Gamma(\beta,\omega_{\beta,A})
\xrightarrow{\ \varepsilon_{a_\beta}\ }A,
$$

where the first arrow is the composite

$$
A=R\Gamma(s,A_s)
\xrightarrow{\ R\Gamma(s,\eta_\beta)\ }
R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta*}A_\beta)
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }
R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta!}A_\beta)=R\Gamma(\beta,A_\beta),
$$

whose first map is $R\Gamma(s,-)$ applied to the unit of the
adjunction $La_\beta^*\dashv Ra_{\beta*}$ of the
derived direct image, and
whose second is the identification $Ra_{\beta*}\cong Ra_{\beta!}$ for
the proper $a_\beta$
of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] (so that
$R\Gamma(\beta,-)=R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta!}-)$); and the last arrow is
the composite

$$
R\Gamma(\beta,\omega_{\beta,A})
=R\Gamma(s,Ra_{\beta!}Ra_\beta^!A_s)
\xrightarrow{\ R\Gamma(s,\varepsilon_{a_\beta})\ }
R\Gamma(s,A_s)=A,
$$

where $\varepsilon_{a_\beta}$ is the counit of the adjunction
$Ra_{\beta!}\dashv Ra_\beta^!$ of
[def-trf-admissibility], applied to
$\omega_{\beta,A}=Ra_\beta^!A_s$ of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex].

split_report.summary: Definition-only split with no new nodes. Followed the current main-20261015 update and retained its unit/proper-comparison/counit composite. Made every construction ingredient a statement dependency. Replaced the obsolete citation of the direct-image definition for adjunction by the existing pro-etale derived-adjunction definition; constructed the proper comparison using the identity compactification and the existing coherence theorem on its bounded etale-origin domain. Made the exact point-sections functor, scalar extraction, and counit component at A_s explicit. No additional geometric hypothesis, ambient exceptional adjoint, or theorem asserting functoriality/linearity is introduced. Repair of the returned delivery: re-read all sixteen current cited statements, including the updated def-trf-dualizing-complex; explicitly specialize its constructible exceptional inverse image to Y=beta and identify that functor with the adjunction used for the counit. Its Verdier-dual action and evaluation clauses are not used. The finite coefficient ring, bounded constructible finite-Tor input and etale-origin comparison domain remain the ones supplied by the current DAG. On continuation, verified that all sixteen current statement fingerprints agree with the retained repair review, and made fullness explicit so that every ambient morphism tau is an input to the restricted compact-support functor.

One commit with two files (item and report); no new nodes; no SGA. I compared the item clause by clause with main-20261015 sk-d-integral/def-trf-integration.md (order 2627) and blueprint_update. The setting, unit, proper identification, Ra_!(tau), counit and scalar codomain all agree; nothing is added, dropped or weakened. The coefficient category is the finite discrete D(T_proet,A_T), the same one used by def-trf-dualizing-complex and def-trf-admissibility. This is not a target node, so the base-change morphism comparison does not apply. Against the current statements of all 16 cited nodes: (1) Ra^! in omega=Ra^!A_s is the specified constructible right adjoint of def-trf-admissibility. (2) A_T is in D^b_ctf (lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible clause 1, Tor [0,0]); omega is in D^b_ctf because Ra^! lands there; def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude makes D^b_ctf a full subcategory, so every tau is a valid input. (3) lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin (ii) is stated for the intrinsic D^b_c, which equals def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility; so both inputs have etale-origin witnesses. (4) def-weil-derived-direct-image defines Rf_* as the derived functor of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, which gives Lu^* -| Ru_* with c^f_A from def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom; so eta is well typed. (5) (id_beta,a) is an object of Comp(a) (def-weil-compactifications-refinements); extension by zero along id is canonically the identity; prop-compactification-coherence-detailed gives the natural map P_a: Ra_* -> Ra_! on the etale-origin domain. (6) The counit is evaluated at A_s, with source Ra_!omega. (7) lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact gives exact sections; Gamma(s,A_s)=A; the scalar is H^0(v)(1), with no field hypothesis needed. Edge cases beta=s, empty beta, tau=0, nonreduced beta and n>1 are all consistent.
